services.name: Hatha Yoga
services.desc: Cultivate a sense of ease, strength, and grace to meet the transitions of pregnancy, labor, and new motherhood. This practice supports both prenatal and postnatal stages, helping you build resilience, relieve tension, and prepare your body and mind for this new life chapter. Feel supported in community with other women moving through the same journey. Classes are appropriate for all levels and stages of pregnancy. Partners, postpartum mothers, and pre-crawling babies are also welcome. blurb: This was the 3rd time I’ve done yoga in my entire life, but can honestly say this felt like the first time. When I walked in I was pleasantly greeted by Datza and Roman. They were beyond informative and extremely professional. After registering I walked towards the back where the classes are held and was honestly shocked at how well done the place looked. It certainly contributed to a much better experience.
